text: The only difference between me and a madman is that I'm not mad.
author: Salvador Dalí

archive.text: It isn't the thing you do, dear, it's the thing you leave undone, that gives you a bit of a heartache at the setting of the sun.
archive.author: Margaret Sangster

archive.text: You must not lose faith in humanity. Humanity is an ocean; if a few drops of the ocean are dirty, the ocean does not become dirty.
archive.author: Mahatma Gandhi

archive.text: The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.
archive.author: Marcus Aurelius

archive.text: It is because I dive into the abyss that I am beginning to love the abyss I am made of.
archive.author: Clarice Lispector

archive.text: Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
archive.author: Haruki Murakami

archive.text: Each day provides its own gifts.
archive.author: Marcus Aurelius

archive.text: Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
archive.author: Les Brown
